controls.name: Agent Sandbox Isolation
controls.description: Agent code runs in gVisor (runsc). Blocked syscalls, capabilities dropped, readOnlyRootFilesystem, non-root UID. All 10 escape techniques are blocked AND detected by Falco/Tetragon.

breakTest.description: Comment out one escape-blocking assertion → suite must fail

controls.name: Concurrency Safety
controls.description: Project store operations are safe under concurrent access. No lost updates, no phantom reads, no torn writes across 10 concurrent goroutines.

breakTest.description: Remove mutex around store write → go test -race must report DATA RACE

controls.name: Runtime Threat Detection (Falco)
controls.description: 13 Falco rules covering all 8 attack categories. 10/10 break test techniques produce detectable Falco events within 30s.

breakTest.description: Delete one CEREBRO_ rule → rule count check must fail

controls.name: eBPF Enforcement (Tetragon)
controls.description: 9 Tetragon TracingPolicies. 6 high-risk techniques trigger SIGKILL before the syscall completes.

breakTest.description: Delete one TracingPolicy entry → policy count check must fail

controls.name: Admission Policy (Kyverno)
controls.description: ClusterPolicy require-signed-images enforces Cosign signature + SBOM attestation in cerebro-prod/staging. Tested with 5 Kyverno CLI test vectors.

breakTest.description: Remove ClusterPolicy kind from manifest → check must find 0 matching files

controls.name: OpenAPI Drift Detection
controls.description: NestJS OpenAPI spec is generated on every PR touching forge-api/src. Drift from committed spec fails the PR. Every non-health path requires bearerAuth.

breakTest.description: Delete openapi-drift.yml → workflow-check must report ARCHITECTURE_FAILURE
